overview: The Medford Traffic Commission met to address several residential parking variances, fire department safety requests, and intersection sightline improvements. The commission approved numerous parking restrictions for emergency vehicle access and established new resident permit parking for a block of Quincy Street.

items.title: Meeting Minutes Approval
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the June 9, 2026, meeting.

items.title: 2026-34: Permit Parking Variance - 64 Salem Street
items.summary: Approved a parking variance for Eric Sharp to park on Oakland Street because his residence lacks off-street parking and is located on a metered section of Salem Street.

items.title: 2026-35: Permit Parking Variance - 239 Boston Avenue
items.summary: Approved a parking variance for two vehicles on North Street for residents Gota Avra Sarala and Jesse Rackison.

items.title: 2026-36: Handicap Parking Sign - 63 Linwood Street
items.summary: Approved the installation of a handicap parking sign for Patricia Good.

items.title: 2026-41: Permit Parking - Quincy Street
items.summary: Approved residential permit parking for the block of Quincy Street between Osgoode and Capon Streets. Neighbors petitioned for the change to address persistent issues with out-of-state vehicles and long-term storage of cars by non-residents.

items.title: 2026-48: Permit Parking Variance - 132 North Street
items.summary: Approved a parking variance for resident Connor Baston to park in the permitted section of North Street while the city reviews complex municipal boundary lines with Somerville.

items.title: 2026-49: Visitor Pass Request - 5 Sherborne Court
items.summary: Approved the issuance of two visitor passes for Michael Dunham for use on Bow Street, resolving a jurisdictional issue where the property is in Medford but the street is partly in Somerville.

items.title: 2026-47: Permit Parking Variance - Wellesley Street
items.summary: Tabled the petition because the applicant was not present.

items.title: 2026-37: Stop Sign - Stearns Avenue at College Avenue
items.summary: Approved the installation of a stop sign on Stearns Avenue at the intersection of College Avenue to establish right-of-way.

items.title: 2026-38: No Parking Anytime - 52 Metcalf Street
items.summary: Approved a No Parking Tow Zone in front of 52 Metcalf Street to facilitate Fire Department apparatus navigation through a tight 90-degree turn. The restriction involves the loss of one space, which is offset by the removal of a nearby unused handicap parking spot.

items.title: 2026-39: No Parking Anytime - 25-31 Elliott Street
items.summary: Approved a No Parking Tow Zone covering three spaces on the outer curve of Elliott Street for fire department access. The Fire Department provided photographic evidence of apparatus becoming stuck on the corner due to vehicles parked on both sides.

items.title: 2026-40: Visitor Pass Replacement Fee Increase
items.summary: Approved increasing the replacement cost for lost visitor passes to $15 for the first replacement and $20 for subsequent replacements to discourage abuse. The new fees include seniors and will take effect in the 2027 permit year.

items.title: 2026-42 & 2026-43: No Parking - Walnut Street and Thomas Street
items.summary: Approved parking restrictions near the intersection of Walnut and Thomas Streets to improve sightlines for drivers exiting Thomas Street.

items.title: 2026-44, 45, 46: Corner Parking Offsets - Hancock Street Area
items.summary: Approved a series of corner parking restrictions at the intersections of Hancock Street with Kenway, Elliott, Willis, and Hancock Avenue to address safety concerns regarding sightlines and overflow parking from a nearby business.
